question: Where can I buy XLM with the lowest fees?

golden.answer: There is no universal cheapest place to buy XLM: availability, spreads, withdrawal fees and payment methods vary by country and change often, and no network-wide count of ramps stays true. Compare regulated providers that serve your location by all-in cost for your amount, and confirm the Stellar withdrawal network and any memo requirement before buying. Treat unsolicited “discount XLM” offers as red flags.
keyFacts: No provider is universally cheapest; availability and fees vary by country and time.
Compare all-in cost, and confirm the Stellar withdrawal network and any memo requirement.
Unsolicited discount offers and DMs are not trusted on-ramps.
avoid: Do NOT name a universally cheapest provider or invent a network-wide ramp count.
